set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Define static and dynamic workflow structures for validate -> preprocess -> estimate -> postprocess -> summarize, plus PreprocessReceipt, EstimatorReceipt, ConnectivityDiagnostics, ConvergenceReport, and NumericalWarning ADTs. The workflow should compose with scalafim-pipeline later but not depend on scheduler/runtime code. Acceptance: static and dynamic workflows are distinct, illegal static/dynamic step mixes fail at construction or by type, and tests prove deterministic descriptions/receipts.
set.title: Connectivity workflow bones and typed receipts
